h:
你好！我不是工作流程方面的专家，但是当我看到这些 Loras 可以实现的速度和质量时，我想将它们与 TCD 调度程序进行比较。也许这很混乱，但也许这会激励某人或为某人工作。

注意事项：

  • 为了完成这项工作，您需要 loras 以及您想要测试的步骤数：

TCD 洛拉斯：TCD LORAS：h1t/TCD-SDXL-LoRA 主要（拥抱脸网)

HyperSD 洛拉斯：HYPERSD LORAS：字节跳动/Hyper-SD 位于 main (拥抱脸网)

照明洛拉斯：字节跳动/SDXL-Lightning 位于 main (拥抱脸网)

LCM洛拉斯：主要的潜在一致性/lcm-lora-sdxl (拥抱脸网)

  • 对于节点，使用 Comfyui Manager 并“安装缺少的自定义节点”。

  • 您可以发挥 Loras 和 sigma 的强度（sigma 1 表示较少细节，sigma 0 表示烧焦图像。我认为 0.3-0.6 很好）。

结论

在我的测试中，我认为 TCD 和“1step Hypersd”Lora 是最好的。对于“1step Hypersd”Lora，我使用了 5 或 8 个步骤。通过一步，我只能得到一张单色图像。

o.en:
Hi! I'm not an expert in workflows, but when I see the speed and quality that these Loras can achieve, I want to compare them with the TCD scheduler. Maybe it's a mess, but perhaps this will inspire or work for someone.

Notes:

  • To make this work, you'll need the loras with the number of steps you want to test:

TCD Loras:TCD LORAS: h1t/TCD-SDXL-LoRA at main (huggingface.co)

HyperSD Loras:HYPERSD LORAS: ByteDance/Hyper-SD at main (huggingface.co)

Lighting Loras:ByteDance/SDXL-Lightning at main (huggingface.co)

LCM Loras:latent-consistency/lcm-lora-sdxl at main (huggingface.co)

  • For the nodes, use the Comfyui Manager and "install missing custom nodes".

  • You can play with the strength of the Loras and the sigma (sigma 1 for less details, sigma 0 for a burned image. I think 0.3-0.6 is good).

Conclusion

In my test, I think TCD and "1step Hypersd" Lora were the best. For the "1step Hypersd" Lora, I used 5 or 8 steps. With one step, I only get a single color image.
